reply: Guided tour of R Draconis: 6 steps. Touch any control to take over.

steps.say: This is R Draconis: Mira variable (pulsating red giant) with a period of about 245 days. SPHEREx imaged it on 3 dates in D3, from 2025-06-20 to 2026-06-07 (352 days). The view starts on D3 (1.63–2.41 µm).
Play the dates in order. This object does not move at SPHEREx scale; look at its brightness from one date to the next.
Blink compares two dates directly: 2025-06-20 against 2026-06-07. A moving source jumps; a still one only changes brightness, if at all.
The six detectors cover 0.75–5.0 µm, from left to right. In the measurements it is detected in D1, D3, D5, D6 and not in D2, D4.
Its core is saturated in some detectors: those pixels have no data and are shown in purple. The flags layer marks the pixels the SPHEREx pipeline flagged.
The rule-based engine labels it a star; that agrees with the catalog type (star, SIMBAD).
